''See also: [[The Book of Eternal Night Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Book of Eternal Night is a unique [[Divine Treasure]] and the first of its kind, originally crafted by the [[Monarch Malice]] for her successor. Unlike the standard books left to [[Akura clan|Akura]] experts, which contain seven pages and seven techniques for testing descendants, this book represents [[Malice]]'s idealized version of a [[shadow Path]]. While she practiced a pure [[shadow Path]] focused on utility and power, the book serves as a guide to the perfect path she desired for herself. It is composed of bright violet light with spinning [[script-circle|script-circles]] on its cover and contains the seven techniques a [[Monarch]] would have mastered. Each of its pages functions as a mental and [[spiritual space]] infused with [[Malice]]'s memories, will, and power. These pages include environments such as a nightmare [[labyrinth]] used for training resistance against terror. The book is currently held by [[Mercy]], the daughter of [[Malice]], who uses its techniques to fuel her rapid [[advancement]]. Although it provides a foundation for an entire [[Path]], the book's structure is tied to [[Mercy]]'s spirit and can be used to unleash potent abilities, such as the Overlord [[madra]] or techniques found within its specific pages.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Book of Eternal Night is a collection of separate constructs designed to contain [[Malice's ideal Path]], with every page holding her memories and will. While the volume includes pages used for training, its sixth page serves as a specific room to teach [[Mercy]] a technique and prepare her for the rank of [[Archlord]]. The book is compatible with [[Mercy]]'s spirit, allowing her to study its contents and absorb [[Malice]]'s instincts. As [[Mercy]] adapts to the object, she uses it to house the [[Authority|authority]] borrowed from her mother, though the book is destined to end at the [[Monarch]] stage. The seventh page manifests as a battlefield suffused with [[Mercy]]'s own spirit and will.}}
